description: Refused comment.create writes (POST /repos/acme/widgets/issues/7/comments): one exchange per row of the bh-mqvdq refusal table, each with the exact one-line diagnostic and port error the adapter must raise. Used by tests/test_tracker_github_comment_write.py.
